state:
Hello Support,

I hope this finds you well. I'm the office manager at Lakeside Family Clinic and I've been meaning to write for a while, partly to say thank you - Priya on your team walked me through setting up the waitlist feature back in June and she was incredibly patient with me, so please pass that on.

The actual reason I'm writing though is that the appointment reminder texts seem to have stopped going out. I noticed it Monday when two patients no-showed and both said they never got a reminder. I checked the Messaging settings page and the toggle is still on, and the template hasn't changed since spring. Our front desk has started calling patients manually the day before, which is fine for now but it takes Maria most of the afternoon and we can't keep that up with flu season starting.

Separately, and this is much less important, our latest invoice has a line called 'SMS overage' that I don't understand, since if anything we sent fewer texts this month. Not a big deal, I just want to understand it at some point.

Oh, and one wish-list item: it would be lovely if reminders could go out in Spanish for patients who prefer it.

If it's easier to talk this through, my direct line is 555-0142, I'm in most mornings.

Thanks so much,
Helen Ortiz
Lakeside Family Clinic
